tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; RA study, not cancer study.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: RA patient microbiotas were sensitive to MTX and changes in gut bacterial taxa and gene family abundance were distinct between responders and non-responders.
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified across different levels of microbial analysis and clinical parameters

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: MTX-R exhibited a significant decrease in Bacteroidetes relative to MTX-NR; gene families with q<0.25 were considered significant.
biomarker_unit.notes: Units vary by measurement type (taxonomic, genetic, clinical)

value: 96 gene families passed multiple testing correction
biomarker_value.evidence_quote: High-dose MTX altered 14 bacterial genera and 81 amplicon sequence variants (ASVs); 6,409 gene families were differentially abundant over time at nominal p-value<0.05, 96 passed correction.
biomarker_value.section: Results — Gnotobiotic mice and Clinical relevance
biomarker_value.notes: Values represent counts of differentially abundant features or fold changes in clinical metrics
